prompt: Both the manifest pin and the recipient allow-list stopped this run. Why keep the manifest pin if egress is already allow-listed?
options: A future description can steer the agent through a channel that is already allowed
Allow-lists only work for web requests, not email
The pin replaces the need for attestation
asserts: you can say what each cut protects against that the other does not
pass_message: Right. Egress is the backstop; the registry stops the next tool that leaks through an allowed channel.
fail_message: Think about a description that tells the agent to send data to an address that is on the allow-list.
